question: Should experimental `claws update` be allowed to leave an `update_partial` result requiring manual inspection/replanning, or must it ship with a durable operation identity and a supported Doctor/retry/reconcile recovery flow for package-installer and Gateway failures?
rationale: The code can fail closed and preserve uncertainty, but it cannot determine the acceptable operator-recovery promise after an external mutation has an unknown outcome; that is a core product, support, and security-boundary decision.

options.title: Require durable recovery before merge
options.body: Define the recovery owner and user-facing Doctor/reconcile or retry flow, then review exact-head live proof for the external mutation and recovery paths.

options.title: Accept the narrow experimental contract
options.body: Permit fail-closed `update_partial` with manual inspection/replanning, explicitly documenting that no automatic reconciliation guarantee is provided.

recommendation.title: Require durable recovery before merge
recommendation.body: Define the recovery owner and user-facing Doctor/reconcile or retry flow, then review exact-head live proof for the external mutation and recovery paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes a core experimental lifecycle contract and its operator support guarantee.
